answer.summary: E2E job failed because the openaev-app container stopped during startup, before the API was ready. The log has a Spring Boot LoggingFailureAnalysisReporter ERROR, which means the application context failed to start. The change is a Renovate bump of spring-boot-starter-parent to 4.x in pom.xml, so a deterministic startup failure from the framework upgrade is the likely cause. The log is truncated before the actual failure reason, so confirm the root cause in the full log.
